subject: Culture
title: Secular Pilgrimages
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Secular Pilgrimages.

hook.text: Elvis fans visit Graceland on the anniversary of his death and hold candlelight vigils. It looks exactly like worship.

buildup.text: Secular pilgrimages follow religious patterns: journey, arrival, ritual at the site, transformation, and return.

discovery.text: Auschwitz, Ground Zero, and Robben Island receive millions who seek meaning rather than blessings.

twist.text: Sports fans make pilgrimages to stadiums. Fenway Park and Camp Nou are shrines to tribal identity.

climax.text: Psychologists confirm secular pilgrims report the same emotional shifts as religious ones: awe, grief, renewal.

punchline.text: The pilgrimage instinct outlived the gods it served.

quiz.question: What emotional responses do secular and religious pilgrims share?
